limitations: Six controlled signed-axis priors on one public drive; not independent calibration recovery or confidence.
Reference values are never optimized against. Reference errors do not establish accuracy; covariance/observability unknown.
Raw scans are not motion compensated and FeatDepth training overlap with KITTI raw is possible.
Historical maps were generated using another Torch version. No claim of exact historical numerical equality.
Six default-six-thread CPU-depth estimates added after detecting thread-count-dependent depth differences; fixed priors/split retained, no tuning.
Parsed values and embedded JSON notes normalize external/workspace paths; original content digests are retained.

protocol.failure_policy: Preserve failed/partial trials and available standard results; never replace an unavailable candidate with CPU output.
protocol.initial_estimate_policy: Controlled demo initialization: dataset reference plus fixed local Euler offsets. Rotation deg xyz=(0.5, 0.0, 0.0); camera-frame translation m xyz=(0.5, 0.0, 0.0). This is not an independently measured prior.
protocol.split_policy: 25 numeric-ordered, uniformly selected provider positions; every fifth frame is holdout (20 fit / 5 holdout), fixed before optimization.
protocol.tuning_policy: Frozen six signed-axis problems and checkpoint; FP32 CPU/serial CUDA/batched CUDA depth; no holdout-based tuning.
